metadata.title: An engagement‑aware predictive model to evaluate problem‑solving performance from the study of adult skills’ (PIAAC 2012) process data

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use ILSA achievement data as an outcome or predictor, focusing instead on process log data.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The manuscript explicitly states that it does not report applying PIAAC sampling weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes process log data rather than student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods but does not report any validation on external datasets or different cycles.
